description: Na₄Mn₃BO₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with five MnO₆ octahedra, edges with six NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-13°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.49 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four MnO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent MnO₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-24°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.48 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with four MnO₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-24°. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.51 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, and edges with six MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 9-13°. There are four shorter (1.93 Å) and two longer (2.48 Å) Mn-O bond lengths. B is bonded in a distorted square co-planar geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All B-O bond lengths are 1.78 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na and three Mn atoms to form distorted ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra that share corners with five ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₃Mn₂ square pyramid, edges with ten ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₃Mn₂ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-4°. In the second O site, O is bonded to three Na and two equivalent Mn atoms to form distorted ONa₃Mn₂ square pyramids that share corners with nine ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra, edges with six ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent ONa₃Mn₂ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-103°. In the third O site, O is bonded to three equivalent Na, one Mn, and two equivalent B atoms to form distorted ONa₃MnB₂ octahedra that share corners with four ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra, corners with six equivalent ONa₃Mn₂ square pyramids, edges with seven ONa₃MnB₂ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₃Mn₂ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and three Mn atoms to form distorted ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra that share corners with four ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra, corners with two equivalent ONa₃Mn₂ square pyramids, edges with nine ONa₃Mn₃ octahedra, and edges with three equivalent ONa₃Mn₂ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-6°.
